docs.summary: Rewrites the trajectory so the travel after the warp window heads along `targetDirection`, spreading the turn over the window. Null when there is nothing to warp.

members.name: WarpTrajectory
members.signature: public static Transform3D[] WarpTrajectory(RootMotion rootMotion, Float3 desiredTotalDelta, float windowStart, float windowEnd, float startTime)

docs.summary: Rewrites the trajectory so the total displacement becomes `desiredTotalDelta`, warping only the frames inside the window. The horizontal path is turned and scaled, the vertical offset linearly.
